projects.title: ConfoSense
projects.summary: Making building alerts more reliable by giving forecasts a measure of uncertainty.
projects.problem: Accurate forecasts alone do not tell a building operator which deviations deserve attention.
projects.approach: A common evaluation protocol links forecasting, conformal intervals, and causal alert generation across building temperature, energy, and HVAC tasks.
projects.outcome: Evaluates fault detection, alert workload, detection delay, robustness, and recalibration. The contribution is a monitoring methodology and empirical validation.
projects.note: Results are bounded to the declared datasets and synthetic-fault protocols. This is research evidence, not a deployed building-control system.

projects.title: Quipus / Fovea
projects.summary: Exploring the space between a compact recording device and useful conversation memory.
projects.problem: Decisions and follow-ups are easily lost between a conversation and the next piece of work.
projects.approach: An ongoing hardware exploration is paired with a product website and a searchable sample workspace for conversations, people, and follow-ups.
projects.outcome: The frontend supports sample conversation search, connected notes, local follow-up completion, and note and calendar exports.
projects.note: The public workspace uses fictional sample data. Recording, transcription, device pairing, and backend sync are not implemented in that frontend prototype.

projects.title: APR intelligence
projects.summary: Turning physical-design and timing reports into a consistent engineering dashboard.
projects.problem: APR and static timing metrics need consistent structure before engineers can compare progress and identify problems.
projects.approach: Structured submissions, metric schemas, and HTML dashboards bring reporting into one reproducible workflow.
projects.outcome: A public implementation with submission examples, documented schemas, and dashboard generation.
projects.note: The portfolio links to the public tool. No employer design databases, internal reports, or proprietary chip results are included.

projects.title: ProcurePilot
projects.summary: A procurement copilot for decisions where price is only part of the story.
projects.problem: SME buyers need to weigh lead time, availability, and supplier risk during supply disruptions.
projects.approach: A transparent scoring model ranks regional supplier profiles, with adjustable weights, substitute options, and risk explanations.
projects.outcome: A working MVP with seeded requests, supplier comparisons, SQLite persistence, and a Lua-backed assessment flow.
projects.note: Supplier data and negotiation scenarios are demonstrations. The repository documents the configuration required for live agent services.

projects.title: RoomLab
projects.summary: A shared molecular playground that makes learning a team activity.
projects.problem: Collaborative spatial experiences need shared ownership, alignment, and meaningful learning tasks.
projects.approach: Learners assemble molecules, inspect geometry, and answer synchronized quizzes in a shared browser scene.
projects.outcome: A browser simulator, authoritative room-state model, relay server, ownership rules, and late-join hydration.
projects.note: Spectacles and Lens Studio integrations use adapter interfaces and mocked alignment. The playable demonstration is the browser simulator.

projects.title: GotongFlow
projects.summary: Making team contributions, ownership, and blockers easier to see.
projects.problem: Messy notes can hide who owns a task, what is blocked, and how credit should be shared.
projects.approach: Turn team notes into a visual collaboration map, attach proof of work, and explore contribution reports.
projects.outcome: An interactive MVP with local parsing and an optional server-side inference integration.
projects.note: The contribution-proof and transaction hashes are mock demonstrations, not on-chain verification.

projects.title: OCI field tools
projects.summary: Small, focused tools for understanding cloud configuration and operational risk.
projects.problem: Cloud inventory, tagging, and exposure checks are repetitive when handled manually.
projects.approach: Purpose-built command-line reporters inspect inventory, tags, networking, backups, and policy drift.
projects.outcome: A suite of public OCI repositories with configuration templates and portable setup instructions.
projects.note: These are independent tools. Review each repository's permissions and upload behavior before running against a cloud account.

projects.title: Hybrid solar lighting
projects.summary: An engineering initiative at the intersection of lighting, energy, and practical impact.
projects.problem: Sustainable lighting calls for solutions that connect energy engineering with real-world implementation.
projects.approach: A hybrid solar lighting project developed at Monash University Malaysia, with continued project leadership and youth-energy engagement.
projects.outcome: Featured by Springwise and nominated for the James Dyson Award 2021. Selected for YSEH Cohort 4 in 2026.
projects.note: Recognition describes the project and selection record; it does not imply commercial deployment.
